'''Ucell''' ({{langx|uz|Ucell}}) is the largest [[mobile network]] brand in [[Uzbekistan]], owned and operated by the Uzbek company COSCOM, itself owned by State Committee of the Republic of Uzbekistan for Assistance to Privatized Enterprises and Development of Competition (a governmental authority of Uzbekistan). The Ucell network offers [[mobile telephony]] and [[mobile internet]] services in Uzbekistan using [[GSM]], [[UMTS]], [[High Speed Packet Access|HSPA]], [[LTE (telecommunication)|LTE]] and [[5G]] technologies.

Ucell was established in 1996 under the brand Coscom. [[Telia Company]] became the majority owner in 2007 and the company changed its name into Ucell in 2008. On 5 December 2018, [[Telia Company]] sold its interest in Ucell to the State Committee of the Republic of Uzbekistan for Assistance to Privatized Enterprises and Development of Competition, a governmental authority of Uzbekistan, for a price corresponding to $215 million on a debt free basis. On this date company has roughly 1,250 employees and 7.1 million subscribers. Ucell's 2G network covers approximately 97% of Uzbekistan and its 3G network covers roughly 60% of the country.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.teliacompany.com/en/news/press-releases/2018/12/telia-company-divests-its-interest-in-ucell/ |title=Telia Company divests its interest in Ucell |work=Telia |date=2018-12-05 |lang=en |archiveurl=https://archive.today/20181205165837/https://www.teliacompany.com/en/news/press-releases/2018/12/telia-company-divests-its-interest-in-ucell/ |archivedate=2018-12-05 |accessdate=2018-12-05}}</ref>

On 29 September 2021, COSCOM MCHJ, together with USM Telecom and [[MegaFon]], concluded the establishment phase of Digital Holding joint venture.<ref>{{Cite web |title=O‘zbekistonda Digital Holding faoliyat boshlamoqda. Unga Ucell’ning sobiq bosh direktori rahbarlik qiladi |url=https://kun.uz/news/2021/09/30/ozbekistonda-digital-holding-faoliyat-boshlamoqda?q=/uz/news/2021/09/30/ozbekistonda-digital-holding-faoliyat-boshlamoqda |access-date=2024-04-16 |website=Kun.uz |language=uz}}</ref>
